verses: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا
ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرًا
مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا
وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلًا
مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًا
وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا

قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا

matches.label: Destruction motivated by human wickedness or violence
matches.note: Motive changed: Genesis gives moral corruption and violence (rabbāh rāʿat hā-ʾādām ... wa-ttimmālēʾ hā-ʾāreṣ ḥāmās; hišḥît kol bāśār ʾet darkô). Q 71 gives rejection of the messenger and idolatry: rabbi innahum ʿaṣawnī ... wa-qālū lā tadharunna ālihatakum wa-lā tadharunna waddan wa-lā suwāʿan wa-lā yaghūtha wa-yaʿūqa wa-nasrā. Five named gods; Genesis names no god but YHWH/Elohim.

passages.text: וַיַּ֣רְא יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י רַבָּ֛ה רָעַ֥ת הָאָדָ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְכָל יֵ֨צֶר֙ מַחְשְׁבֹ֣ת לִבּ֔וֹ רַ֥ק רַ֖ע כָּל הַיּֽוֹם
וַתִּשָּׁחֵ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ לִפְנֵ֣י הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַתִּמָּלֵ֥א הָאָ֖רֶץ חָמָֽס
וַיַּ֧רְא אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת הָאָ֖רֶץ וְהִנֵּ֣ה נִשְׁחָ֑תָה כִּֽי הִשְׁחִ֧ית כָּל בָּשָׂ֛ר אֶת דַּרְכּ֖וֹ עַל הָאָֽרֶץ
قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلًا

matches.label: Hero asks the deity to judge or destroy his opponents
matches.note: Who calls for destruction is reversed: in Genesis God decides alone (wa-yyōʾmer YHWH ʾemḥeh ʾet hā-ʾādām; we-hinnî mašḥîtām ʾet hā-ʾāreṣ) and even regrets creating (wa-yyinnāḥem YHWH). In Q 71:26-27 Noah asks: rabbi lā tadhar ʿalā l-arḍi mina l-kāfirīna dayyāran, innaka in tadharhum yuḍillū ʿibādaka. There is no divine regret in the Quran.

passages.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה אֶמְחֶ֨ה אֶת הָאָדָ֤ם אֲשֶׁר בָּרָ֨אתִי֙ מֵעַל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה מֵֽאָדָם֙ עַד בְּהֵמָ֔ה עַד רֶ֖מֶשׂ וְעַד ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֥י נִחַ֖מְתִּי כִּ֥י עֲשִׂיתִֽם
וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֜ים לְנֹ֗חַ קֵ֤ץ כָּל בָּשָׂר֙ בָּ֣א לְפָנַ֔י כִּֽי מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָ֛רֶץ חָמָ֖ס מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וְהִנְנִ֥י מַשְׁחִיתָ֖ם אֶת הָאָֽרֶץ
وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا

matches.label: Seek forgiveness and repent, and God will send the sky down on you in abundant rain
matches.note: Rain reversed: in Genesis rain from opened sky is the destruction (wa-ʾărubbōt ha-ššāmayim niftāḥû, wa-yehî ha-ggešem ʿal hā-ʾāreṣ ʾarbāʿîm yôm). Noah in Q 71:10-11 promises rain as blessing if they repent: istaghfirū rabbakum ... yursili s-samāʾa ʿalaykum midrāran, then (71:25) mimmā khaṭīʾātihim ughriqū: the sky that could have blessed them drowns them.

matches.note: The saved are defined by faith, not by house: Gen 7:1 bōʾ ʾattāh we-kol bêtkā ʾel ha-ttēvāh kî ʾōtkā rāʾîtî ṣaddîq. Q 71:28 rabbi ghfir lī wa-li-wālidayya wa-li-man dakhala baytiya muʾminan wa-li-l-muʾminīna wa-l-muʾmināt: whoever enters my house as a believer.

matches.label: Deity resolves or promises not to repeat the destruction
matches.note: Ending changed: Genesis ends with Noah's sacrifice and God's promise lōʾ ʾōsîf leqallēl ʿôd ʾet hā-ʾădāmāh ... we-lōʾ ʾōsîf ʿôd lehakkôt ʾet kol ḥay. Q 71 ends with the drowned sent on into fire (ughriqū fa-udkhilū nāran) and Noah's prayer of forgiveness and of destruction (wa-lā tazidi ẓ-ẓālimīna illā tabārā). No sacrifice, no covenant, no 'never again'.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/08-hb-quran.yaml).

Shared motifs, rarest first: Human created in stages: a drop of sperm (nutfa), a clinging clot ('alaq/'alaqa), then shaped and proportioned (weight 5.4); Human comes from dust and returns to dust (weight 5.0); First human shaped from dust, clay or soil (weight 4.6). Pair score 15.0.

Only in Job - 'Your hands fashioned me'; land of darkness: The sufferer reminds God that God's hands shaped him yet now destroy him; 'Have you eyes of flesh? Are your days like a mortal's days?'; God hunts the sufferer like a lion; The underworld as a land of darkness and deep shadow, without order, where light is like darkness; God created Adam 'with my two hands'; God creates you in your mothers' bellies creation after creation in three darknesses; God's crafting of the human body, and what is said to follow from it [divergence between the texts]; Like a vanishing cloud, whoever goes down to Sheol does not come up; his place knows him no more; From dust, then a drop, then a clinging clot ('alaqa), then a child, then full strength, then old age; some die before; Have you seen what you emit? Do you create it, or are we the creator?; Sufferer wishes he had died in the womb or been a hidden stillborn; God poured the embryo out like milk and curdled it like cheese, clothing it with skin and flesh and knitting bones and sinews.

Only in Noah's preaching, the five idols and the flood: Because of their sins they were drowned and then made to enter a fire; The people put their fingers in their ears and wrap their garments over their heads to avoid hearing the prophet; Noah's people refuse to abandon their gods Wadd, Suwa', Yaghuth, Ya'uq and Nasr; The flood hero prays for forgiveness for himself, his parents, whoever enters his house believing, and all believers; God caused humans to grow from the earth like a plant, returns them to it and will bring them out again; Prophet summons his people night and day, openly and in secret, yet they only flee further; Human comes from dust and returns to dust [divergence between the texts]; Deity resolves or promises not to repeat the destruction [divergence between the texts]; Destruction motivated by human wickedness or violence [divergence between the texts]; Seek forgiveness and repent, and God will send the sky down on you in abundant rain [divergence between the texts]; God created seven heavens in layers (sab' samawat tibaqan) or built seven strong (heavens) above humans; The sun is made a lamp (siraj), a blazing lamp, and the moon a light (nur) within the heavens; and 11 more.

passages.text: וַיִּגְוַ֞ע כָּל בָּשָׂ֣ר הָרֹמֵ֣שׂ עַל הָאָ֗רֶץ בָּע֤וֹף וּבַבְּהֵמָה֙ וּבַ֣חַיָּ֔ה וּבְכָל הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל הָאָ֑רֶץ וְכֹ֖ל הָאָדָֽם
כֹּ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁמַת ר֨וּחַ חַיִּ֜ים בְּאַפָּ֗יו מִכֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֶּחָֽרָבָ֖ה מֵֽתוּ

וַיִּ֜מַח אֶֽת כָּל הַיְק֣וּם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֗ה מֵאָדָ֤ם עַד בְּהֵמָה֙ עַד רֶ֨מֶשׂ֙ וְעַד ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיִּמָּח֖וּ מִן הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִשָּׁ֧אֶר אַךְ נֹ֛חַ וַֽאֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ בַּתֵּבָֽה
ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًا

בְּעֶ֨צֶם הַיּ֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ בָּ֣א נֹ֔חַ וְשֵׁם וְחָ֥ם וָיֶ֖פֶת בְּנֵי נֹ֑חַ וְאֵ֣שֶׁת נֹ֗חַ וּשְׁלֹ֧שֶׁת נְשֵֽׁי בָנָ֛יו אִתָּ֖ם אֶל הַתֵּבָֽה
